# Google Form Requests
<cy>A mod by ItzKiba</c>

This mod allows you to do level requests directly in-game by linking to a Google Spreadsheet connected to a Google Form. Follow the instructions in Setup Guide to properly set up the spreadsheet and form.

### Features
* Connecting to a Google Spreadsheet and reading all fields submitted by users.

* Ability to mark levels as seen or unseen. Playing a level will automatically mark it as seen.

* Level weights similar to **Tricipital's** request system. Each level's weight is stored in the mod's save data, and unseen levels will have their weights increased when resetting the form locally in-game. The weight of each individual level can also be manually set to any value if needed.

* Sorting levels by Timestamp and Weight (both ascending and descending).
changelog:
# v1.0.4
* Fixed a touch priority issue with the bottom menu

# v1.0.3
* Changed the visual for a Seen level to make the outline green instead of the entire cell
* The Random button now highlights the level in your response list instead of immediately opening the level page.

# v1.0.2
* Fixed mod logo
* Added a popup to warn the user if the number of local cached levels did not reset when resetting the form locally

# v1.0.1
* Fixed duplicate IDs appearing/being considered for random selection
* Fixed spreadsheet failing to link if it has no responses
* Added a toggle in the mod's settings to opt in/out of the weight system

# v1.0.0
* Release
